episode_row: live picks on a stale season parquet

commits.subject: fix: auto-refresh season data before predictions
commits.body:
run_pipeline now pulls recent game feeds and rebuilds the current season
parquet before running predictions. Skips already-downloaded games so
it's fast for daily use. Set refresh_data=False for backtesting.

Fixes stale features (days_rest, rolling hit rates) caused by parquets
not being rebuilt after new games.
